name: dsh-redteam-gate
description: Verified-scope gate for native active tools (nmap, nuclei, ffuf, gobuster, nikto, sqlmap, Metasploit) and shell commands that invoke them. Lab hosts (loopback) allowed; other domains require SecScan verification; fail closed.

scripts.test: npx tsx --test test/lab-hosts.test.mjs test/scope.test.mjs test/verifier.test.mjs test/runner.test.mjs test/tools.test.mjs test/recon/domain.test.mjs test/recon/passive.test.mjs test/seclayer/redteam-modules.test.mjs test/metasploit/msf.test.mjs test/alterego/allowlist.test.mjs test/alterego/bridge.test.mjs test/alterego/inventory.test.mjs test/alterego/scope-rules.test.mjs test/alterego/registry.test.mjs test/guard/scoped-fetch.test.mjs test/redteam-tools.test.mjs test/render.test.mjs && vitest run test/secscan-network
